items.q: How did Amp reach $100M+ ARR with only 21 people?
items.a: A spin-off freeze meant they **couldn't hire for a year**, which forced an **agent-first way of working** that became the advantage.
**No PMs, no Jira**, **one meeting a week**, everyone talks to customers and everyone holds **real equity**.

items.q: How does Amp push constantly without breaking the site?
items.a: **Chunk work into tiny pushes**, **add logging first**, let the agent **watch each push for an hour**, and run shadow systems.

items.q: How can an agent prove a UI fix is correct?
items.a: Have it **compare every frame** visually, a check **no human has the patience** for, and generate many variants at once.

items.q: What does Amp do when a user reports a bug?
items.a: Fixes it with the agent, **emails an apology with credits**, then **finds everyone else who hit the error** in the logs and tells them.

items.q: Why does Quinn Slack think SaaS like Salesforce is at risk?
items.a: Agents make it easy to **build the 2% of features you use**, which undercuts **long sales-led contracts**.
